opportunities.exact_target: For finite M_d with tau=I/d, any bistochastic CP Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint Phi, any fixed bistochastic CP Psi satisfying <H,(I-Psi)H> <= C <H,(I-Phi)H> for every Hermitian H, and every density matrix rho, prove e^3 <= (27C/4) D(rho||tau) b, where e=T(Psi(rho),rho), b=T(Phi(rho),rho), and D is in nats.
opportunities.strongest_audited_prior: Gao-Junge-LaRacuente-Li Theorem 1.1: CP-order mixing of a symmetric QMS implies complete MLSI and relative-entropy decay. Bertini-De Sole-Posta Theorem 2.5: reversible-QMS trace-distance ergodicity through a sigma-GNS chi-square expansion. Carlen-Maas Theorems 5.10 and 7.6 plus Eq. 8.17: modular entropy dissipation and gradient flow under sigma-detailed-balance and intertwining assumptions.
opportunities.mechanism_candidate: Poissonization P_t=exp[-t(I-Phi)] gives a symmetric QMS for applying entropy-dissipation results. Any successful route must retain the first-order trace defect b; the simple product D times a quadratic energy has the wrong near-tau scaling.
opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma: Find a scale-compatible dimension-free bridge from full Hermitian form order to e^3 <= (27C/4)D b that explicitly uses the trace defect or an equivalent first-order quantity. The tempting e^3 <= (27/8) D E_Psi(rho-tau) is false already for a qubit depolarizing channel near tau.
compatibility_obligations: The target assumes quadratic-form order, whereas the closest entropy-decay theorem assumes two-sided complete-positivity order mixing.
The entropy-decay conclusions concern distance to a fixed-point conditional expectation, not the trace displacement under the common map Psi.
All density matrices, including non-full-rank states, must be covered or reached by a justified limit.
A nontracial extension must track sigma-modular means and any sigma_min dependence in conversion to trace norm.
opportunities.early_falsification_test: Check the candidate lemma first on exact commuting examples: small reversible classical chains, rational bistochastic Psi, and rational states. A counterexample must certify e^3/[D E_Psi] > 27/8 exactly or with rigorous interval bounds. No such test was run in this literature task.
opportunities.historical_importance_if_proved: A dimension-free stability inequality converting a common quadratic Dirichlet-form comparison into a cubic trace-disturbance bound, including a modular extension if it can be established without spectrum-dependent loss.
opportunities.novelty_status: unknown; this memo is a narrow source comparison and does not infer novelty from absence
